newsitem.title: USA: US LPGs mixed in choppy trade, little news.
newsitem.headline: US LPGs mixed in choppy trade, little news.

text.p: U.S. spot liquefied petroleum gas prices were mixed in choppy trade on Wednesday, with many eyes on NYMEX following the bearish API report late Tuesday.
In the U.S. Gulf Coast, Mont Belvieu, Texas, propane was a quarter cent weaker at between 35.00 cents and 35.25 cents a gallon.
Conway, Kansas, hub material was steady at 37.00/37.25 cents.
Belvieu normal butane was up a quarter cent higher due to demand to 41.50/42.00 cents. Conway was a quarter cent weaker 38.50/39.00 cents.
"It is spotty market. There is nothing consistent right now," said a Conway trader.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
